Martin Suter

Über uns

Die swisspro Automation AG gestaltet die Zukunft von Gebäuden - energieeffizient, komfortabel und automatisiert. Wir entwickeln intelligente, technologieunabhängige und massgeschneiderte Gebäudeautomationslösungen, die flexibel und zukunftsgerichtet sind. Dabei vernetzen wir Systeme sowie Geräte und stellen eine zentrale Steuerung sicher.

Am Standort in Urdorf bündelt die swisspro Automation AG das Know-how von über 20 qualifizierten Mitarbeitenden. Als Anbieterin von Gesamtlösungen setzen wir anspruchsvolle und innovative Projekte um, die höchste Qualitätsstandards erfüllen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• You create the electrical plans for the MSR automation and clarify technical interfaces independently.
• You program, install, test and commission automation systems (mainly Beckhoff PLC).
• You implement operating, alarm and navigation concepts.
• You support the project management in technical clarifications with internal and external partners and are responsible for project initiation, commissioning and testing for customers.
• You will be involved in the creation of technical documentation.
• You also regularly check the work results to ensure that they meet the specified quality criteria.
• After your training, you will occasionally take on on-call duties (approx. 3 weeks per year) - of course with fair remuneration. What you bring with you
• You have completed vocational training in the areas of automation, electrical installation or electrical engineering/electronics.
• Further training at the FH/HF level is a plus, but not a must.
• Preferably you already have experience with automation programming according to IEC.
• Your strengths include a structured and independent way of working, and you are adaptable and flexible.
• You are characterized by analytical thinking skills and proactive thinking and actions.
• Good knowledge of German and confident technical English round off your profile.
• Bring a category B driving license with you. Questions about the position Christian Brunner CTO 041 229 30 86 We do not want inquiries from personnel service providers.
